section: Bootstrap Diagnostics of Structural Stability (paper Table 4, Figures 4-7)
generator_note: jpse uses legacy np.random.seed + inverse-CDF. scipy.stats.johnsonsu.rvs with default_rng(200612) gives a DIFFERENT sample (range [-4.8695,5.0564] vs [-6.3845,7.0534]); table4_hartigan_real.py used that scipy path, which is why its Hartigan rate (4.00%) does not match the artifacts (1.30%).
bootstrap_scheme: rng = np.random.default_rng(seed*10_000 + b); x_boot = rng.choice(x_orig, size=200, replace=True)
stored_pvals_note: These are for the ORIGINAL realization only. bootstrap_cloud.py copied them onto all 32000 rows of the per-seed checkpoint; it never tested the resamples. Table 4 rejection rates cannot be derived from the checkpoints.

regeneration_check.note: differs at machine epsilon only; the pinned CSV is authoritative

x_orig_unsorted.why: bootstrap_cloud.py line 271 draws rng.choice(x_orig, ...) from the UNSORTED array. Sorting destroys that order, so the sorted artifact alone cannot reproduce the resamples. This file is a jpse regeneration; sort() of it matches the stored artifact to 2.2e-15.

w1_in_this_section.reference: the ORIGINAL realization EQF (Weibull positions), NOT the resample EQF
w1_in_this_section.normalized: w1_normalized = w1_distance / (P90-P10 of the ORIGINAL sample)
